<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="lq-interior-architecture" content="V65 — clean interiors: selective render passes, calm regional design and retained collision" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>LIFEQUEST AI V69 — Art District Neon Carnival City</title>
    <meta name="description" content="LifeQuest AI V69: 20 new enterable creative venues, expanded Art District, all-ages festivals, new lighting, interactable B1 English activities, interactive B1 arts quest, Clean Interiors, Visual Intelligence and Living World Core, Time Echo memories, regional RPG missions, NPC companion, Discovery Camera, museum and adaptive English learning." />
    <meta property="og:title" content="LIFEQUEST AI V64 · VISUAL INTELLIGENCE" />
    <meta property="og:description" content="LifeQuest AI V60: Living World Core, Time Echo memories, regional RPG missions, NPC companion, Discovery Camera, museum and adaptive English learning." />
    <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
    <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><text y=%22.9em%22 font-size=%2290%22>🏘️</text></svg>">
  <style>
html, body {
  color: #eee;
  background: #111;
  margin: 0;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  overflow: hidden;
  user-select: none;
}

#game {
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}

#chat {
  background: #141824f2;
  border: 2px solid #5a6a9a;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: min(720px, 94vw);
  padding: 12px;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%);
  z-index: 30;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

/* Nút ✕ rời cuộc trò chuyện: dành cho điện thoại/máy tính bảng (không có phím Esc).
   sticky để vẫn thấy khi khung chat cuộn trên màn hình nhỏ. */
#chat #chat-close {
  float: right;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  margin: -4px -4px 4px 8px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid #5a6a9a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #242f50;
  color: #eef2ff;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
#chat #chat-close:hover,
#chat #chat-close:active {
  background: #8a2e3c;
  border-color: #d06070;
}

#chat .name {
  color: #ffd36b;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
}

#chat .log {
  max-height: 220px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

#chat .me {
  color: #8fd3ff;
}

.npc {
  color: #fff;
}

.fix {
  color: #9be39b;
  font-size: 13px;
}

#chat .goal {
  color: #c9a0ff;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

#chat input {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: #fff;
  background: #0d1020;
  border: 1px solid #556;
  border-radius: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

#chat input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #7a9ad8;
}

#chat .inrow {
  gap: 8px;
  display: flex;
}

#chat .inrow input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

#chat #mic {
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #2a3150;
  border: 1px solid #556;
  border-radius: 6px;
  width: 44px;
  font-size: 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

#chat #mic:hover {
  background: #3b4570;
}

#chat #mic.on {
  background: #b02a3a;
  border-color: #ff8a8a;
  animation: 1s infinite pulse;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #ff5a5a59;
  }
}

#chat .hint {
  color: #889;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

#chat #teacher {
  color: #9be39b;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #1f3a2f;
  border: 1px solid #5a9a7a;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

#chat #teacher.off {
  color: #889;
  background: #222839;
  border-color: #556;
}

#chat #voice-toggle {
  color: #8fd3ff;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #1b2e4b;
  border: 1px solid #4a75a8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

#chat #voice-toggle.off {
  color: #889;
  background: #222839;
  border-color: #556;
}

.speaker-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-left: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  background: #232c48;
  border: 1px solid #485c8a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  color: #ffd36b;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.speaker-btn:hover {
  background: #36446e;
  transform: scale(1.08);
}

.speaker-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
}

.natural-alt {
  color: #8fd3ff;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: -1px 0 5px 14px;
  font-style: italic;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.voc-badge {
  color: #ffd36b;
  background: #252e18b0;
  border: 1px solid #789038;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 3px 0 6px 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.voc-badge:hover {
  background: #364420;
  border-color: #a0c248;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

#chat .fix {
  margin: -2px 0 4px 14px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

#briefing {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: #141824f5;
  border: 2px solid #5ab8d8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: min(720px, 94vw);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%);
  z-index: 30;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

#briefing .name {
  color: #ffd36b;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
}

#briefing .text {
  color: #fff;
  min-height: 66px;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

#briefing .row {
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  display: flex;
}

#briefing .hint {
  color: #889;
  font-size: 12px;
}

#briefing .step {
  color: #889;
  margin-right: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

#briefing .next {
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: #1f3a4a;
  border: 1px solid #5ab8d8;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 7px 14px;
}

#briefing .next:hover {
  background: #2a5068;
}

#journal {
  background: #141824f2;
  border: 2px solid #8a6aba;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: min(380px, 90vw);
  max-height: 75vh;
  padding: 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 60px;
  right: 16px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 25;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

#journal h3 {
  color: #c9a0ff;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
}

#journal .entry {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #334;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

#journal .meta {
  color: #99a;
  font-size: 12px;
}

#chat .quest {
  color: #ffd36b;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.wcard {
  background: #1b2540;
  border: 1px solid #4a6aa8;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.wterm {
  color: #8fd3ff;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.wmean {
  color: #fff;
}

.wvi {
  color: #ffd36b;
}

.wex {
  color: #9be39b;
  font-style: italic;
}

.wnote {
  color: #99a;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.werr {
  color: #ff8a8a;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.wrow {
  padding: 1px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
}

#helper {
  background: #141824f7;
  border: 2px solid #4a8ad8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: min(500px, 94vw);
  max-height: 85vh;
  padding: 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 40;
  box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}

#helper h3 {
  color: #8fd3ff;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

#helper .row {
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  display: flex;
}

#helper input {
  color: #fff;
  background: #0d1020;
  border: 1px solid #556;
  border-radius: 6px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
}

#helper input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #5ab8d8;
}

#helper button {
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #2a3150;
  border: 1px solid #667;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
}

#helper button:hover {
  background: #3b4570;
}

#helper .hbook {
  border-top: 1px solid #334;
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding-top: 8px;
}

#quests {
  background: #141824f2;
  border: 2px solid #d9a441;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: min(400px, 90vw);
  max-height: 75vh;
  padding: 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 60px;
  left: 16px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 25;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

#quests h3 {
  color: #ffd36b;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
}

#quests .entry {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #334;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

#quests .qt {
  font-weight: 700;
}

#quests .meta {
  color: #99a;
  font-size: 12px;
}

#quests .sdone {
  color: #7a8;
  font-size: 13px;
}

#quests .scur {
  color: #ffd36b;
  font-size: 13px;
}

#toast {
  color: #ffe9a8;
  background: #3c2d0af2;
  border: 2px solid #ffd36b;
  border-radius: 10px;
  max-width: min(520px, 94vw);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%);
  z-index: 50;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  pointer-events: none;
}

#settings {
  background: #141824f7;
  border: 2px solid #5a9a7a;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: min(460px, 92vw);
  padding: 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 45;
  box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}

#settings h3 {
  color: #8fe0b8;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

#settings ol {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  padding-left: 20px;
}

#settings a {
  color: #8fd3ff;
}

#settings label {
  color: #bbc;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: block;
}

#settings input {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: #fff;
  background: #0d1020;
  border: 1px solid #556;
  border-radius: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 3px;
  padding: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: block;
}

#settings input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #5a9a7a;
}

#settings .row {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 10px 0;
  display: flex;
}

#settings button {
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #2a3150;
  border: 1px solid #667;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
}

#settings button:hover {
  background: #3a4470;
}

#settings .status {
  min-height: 18px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

#settings .note {
  color: #889;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
}

#group-btn {
  z-index: 20;
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #1e243cf2;
  border: 2px solid #8a9ad8;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  position: fixed;
  top: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

#group-btn:hover, #group-btn.on {
  background: #3a4470;
  border-color: #a8b8f0;
}

#group-menu {
  z-index: 20;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  clip-path: inset(0 0 100%);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: #141824f7;
  border: 2px solid #8a9ad8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: min(230px, 80vw);
  padding: 8px;
  transition: clip-path 0.35s, opacity 0.2s;
  display: flex;
  position: fixed;
  top: 50px;
  bottom: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

#group-menu.open {
  clip-path: inset(0);
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

#group-menu button {
  text-align: left;
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #232a46;
  border: 1px solid #445;
  border-radius: 8px;
  flex: none;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 3px 0;
  padding: 14px 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  display: flex;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

#group-menu button:hover {
  background: #3a4470;
}

#group-menu kbd {
  color: #ffd36b;
  background: #111526;
  border: 1px solid #667;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace;
}

#group-menu .sep {
  background: #334;
  height: 1px;
  margin: 4px 2px;
}

#group-menu .tip {
  color: #889;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 10px 6px 2px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Conversation helper: only HTML controls; never touches the Phaser world graphics. */
#chat .npc-coach { margin-bottom: 7px; }
#chat #npc-suggest { background: #242f50; color: #c8e9ff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid #425b9f; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; }
#chat #npc-suggest:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; }
#chat #npc-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 5px; }
#chat #npc-suggestions button { color: #d6efff; background: #1b3043; border: 1px solid #39577a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 12px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
#chat #npc-suggestions button:hover { background: #31506a; }


/* Added interaction UI. The existing town, terrain and sprite graphics are unchanged. */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
#lq-loading{position:fixed;z-index:99;top:45%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(520px,92vw);color:#e8f2ff;background:#151e31ee;border:1px solid #6986c3;border-radius:16px;padding:28px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 45px #0008;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
#lq-loading strong{font-size:20px;color:#ffda7a}
#lq-loading .lq-spinner{display:block;font-size:32px;animation:float 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}
#lq-toolbar{position:fixed;left:9px;top:9px;z-index:20;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);pointer-events:auto}
#lq-toolbar button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#c9dbfd;background:#162036ec;border:1px solid #48628b;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0007}
#lq-toolbar button:hover,#lq-toolbar button:focus-visible{background:#283759;color:#fff}
#lq-toolbar .lq-brand{background:#12192bf1;border:1px solid #485981;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px #0008}
.lq-logo{font-weight:900;background:#fbbf2430;color:#fbd36c;border:1px solid #c493423a;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 5px;font-size:13px}
.lq-title{color:#fbd36c;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35}
#ai-online-status{font-size:10px;color:#9baaca;max-width:280px}
#ai-open{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:15px;z-index:42;background:#101c35f5;border:1px solid #78b9ff;color:#e0f2ff;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 9px 28px #0009;cursor:pointer;font-weight:750;padding:12px 15px;font-size:13px}
#ai-open:hover{background:#253968}
#ai-panel{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:15px;width:min(385px,calc(100vw - 28px));height:min(480px,68vh);z-index:45;border:1px solid #688bd0;border-radius:16px;background:#111b2bf5;color:#eaf0ff;box-shadow:0 16px 42px #000c;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
#ai-panel header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #344966}
#ai-panel header strong{font-size:14px;color:#add8ff}
#ai-panel header small{color:#9aaac7;font-weight:400}
#ai-panel button{cursor:pointer}
#copilot-close{background:transparent;border:0;color:#baccdc;font-size:23px;line-height:1;padding:0 5px}
#ai-log{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;user-select:text}
.ai-message{padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;max-width:92%}
.ai-message.mine{background:#3953b7;color:#fff;align-self:flex-end}
.ai-message.theirs{background:#253453;color:#e0eaff;border:1px solid #3a4c71;align-self:flex-start}
#ai-suggestions{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:8px;border-top:1px solid #33425c;overflow-x:auto}
#ai-suggestions button{white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;color:#b8e2ff;background:#28364d;border:1px solid #526482;padding:7px;border-radius:7px}
#ai-form{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:9px;border-top:1px solid #33425c}
#ai-input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #566982;border-radius:9px;color:#fff;background:#0f182a;font-size:13px;outline:0;user-select:text}
#ai-input:focus{border-color:#70baff}
#ai-form button{border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #577dab;background:#2868a2;color:#fff;padding:8px 12px;font-weight:700}
#ai-form button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:default}
#ai-mic.recording{background:#b3264c}
#ai-panel footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:0 10px 10px;font-size:10px;color:#a6b0ca}
#ai-stop{background:transparent;border:0;color:#f6ca7a;font-size:12px}
#ai-busy{padding:0 12px;color:#9dcafe;font-size:11px}
.lq-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:#050916ba;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:14px}
.lq-dialog{background:#17233a;color:#e6efff;width:min(530px,94vw);border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #6a85b6;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000b;padding:18px;max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;line-height:1.55}
.lq-dialog h2{color:#ffd77e;margin:0 0 10px;font-size:20px}.lq-dialog p,.lq-dialog li{font-size:13px}.lq-dialog button{color:#fff;border:1px solid #6688b3;background:#33476c;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.lq-dialog label{display:block;color:#dce7fe;font-size:14px;margin:9px 0}.lq-dialog select,.lq-dialog input[type=range]{max-width:100%}.lq-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
@media(max-width:700px){#lq-toolbar .desktop-extra{display:none}#ai-panel{bottom:72px;height:min(540px,73vh);right:9px}#ai-open{bottom:75px;right:9px}#chat{bottom:68px;max-height:64vh;overflow:auto}#group-btn{bottom:10px!important;right:9px!important}#lq-toolbar{gap:4px}#lq-toolbar button{padding:6px 8px}}


/* AI Coach PRO: controls only. World art & sprites remain exactly as supplied. */
#ai-panel {height:min(560px,78vh);width:min(430px,calc(100vw - 28px))}
#ai-mode-tabs {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:8px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #31425f}
#ai-mode-tabs button {background:#1c2941;color:#bed3ef;border:1px solid #405575;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 1px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}
#ai-mode-tabs button.selected {background:#24639b;border-color:#8fd6ff;color:#fff;font-weight:700}
#ai-busy {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
#ai-busy[hidden] {display:none}
#ai-cancel {border:none;background:none;color:#fed38b;cursor:pointer}
#ai-panel footer {gap:5px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:5px 10px 9px}
#ai-panel footer .ai-tools {display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;margin-left:auto;flex-wrap:wrap}
#ai-panel footer .ai-tools button {border:1px solid #3e5577;border-radius:6px;background:#202f4c;color:#b8d9fa;font-size:12px;padding:4px 6px;min-width:25px}
#ai-panel footer #ai-stop {color:#ffd089}
#ai-mode-note {font-size:10px;flex:1;min-width:132px}
.ai-message {font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;white-space:pre-wrap}
#ai-suggestions {scrollbar-width:thin;flex-shrink:0}
#ai-suggestions button {flex-shrink:0}
#study-stats{color:#c5e4ff;font-size:11px;background:#18263e;padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #324866;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
@media(max-width:700px){#ai-panel {bottom:64px;height:min(540px,73vh)}#ai-panel footer{padding-bottom:6px}#ai-mode-tabs button{font-size:10px}}


/* V5 add-on: UI only. Existing Phaser art/maps, NPC sprites and drawing functions unchanged. */
#rpg-open{position:fixed;z-index:43;right:200px;top:15px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #c69a54;border-radius:10px;background:#181e30ef;color:#fff3dc;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 15px #0009}
#rpg-open:hover{background:#344468}
#rpg-hud{position:fixed;z-index:28;bottom:14px;left:14px;padding:9px 12px;background:#111d30e8;border:1px solid #a78142;border-radius:10px;color:#ffdb91;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0008}
#rpg-hud small{font-size:10px;color:#b4cee8}
.rpg-xp{display:inline-block;width:62px;height:7px;border-radius:8px;background:#344055;overflow:hidden}
.rpg-xp i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#72aafc,#e9cb60)}
#rpg-toast{position:fixed;z-index:82;bottom:63px;left:14px;max-width:min(440px,90vw);padding:10px 14px;color:white;background:#1d3150f5;border:1px solid #e7c174;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 7px 30px #000a;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(8px);transition:.22s}
#rpg-toast.shown{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
#rpg-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
#rpg-panel{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:81;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:22px;background:#050b17a8;box-sizing:border-box;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.rpg-dialog{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:min(800px,98vw);max-height:min(91vh,850px);background:#111929;border:2px solid #7e9ac7;border-radius:16px;color:#e8f1ff;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000c;overflow:hidden}
.rpg-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:13px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #46566e;background:#1b2944}
.rpg-header b{font-size:18px;color:#f9d48b}
#rpg-title{font-size:12px;color:#d6e7ff;margin-top:4px}
#rpg-close{font-size:27px;border:0;color:white;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}
#rpg-tabs{padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;background:#131f33}
#rpg-tabs button{padding:8px 10px;background:#273650;color:#e6eeff;border:1px solid #526486;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
#rpg-tabs button.active{background:#335f91;border-color:#77bbf3;color:#fff}
#rpg-content{padding:17px;overflow:auto;min-height:150px;line-height:1.55;font-size:14px;user-select:text}
#rpg-content h3{margin:4px 0 8px;color:#f5d48c;font-size:18px}
#rpg-content p{margin:6px 0 12px}
#rpg-content button{padding:7px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:#324b71;border:1px solid #758db5;color:white;cursor:pointer}
#rpg-content button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
#rpg-content .rpg-primary{background:#28698c;border-color:#75c4da;font-weight:750}
.rpg-steps{padding-left:27px}
.rpg-steps li{margin-bottom:7px;padding:5px;border-radius:6px;color:#b7bfcb}
.rpg-steps li.current{color:#fff1c1;background:#344566;font-weight:750}
.rpg-steps li.done{color:#7be2ae;text-decoration:line-through}
.rpg-card{background:#1c2a41;border:1px solid #3e5677;border-radius:10px;margin:9px 0;padding:12px}
.rpg-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px}
.rpg-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.rpg-muted,.rpg-card small{font-size:12px;color:#b9c7d9}
.rpg-schedule{padding:3px 5px 3px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#bfd7ee;border-left:2px solid #415c81;margin-left:8px}
.rpg-good{background:#204f3d;border:1px solid #4fbb88;border-radius:12px;padding:18px}
#rpg-memory-form{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 14px}
#rpg-fact{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #6a7d9b;border-radius:8px;background:#0d1728;color:white}
.rpg-dialog footer{border-top:1px solid #405777;padding:9px 13px;color:#aebbd0;font-size:11px}
@media(max-width:1050px){#rpg-open{right:110px;top:61px}.rpg-dialog{max-height:91vh}}
@media(max-width:640px){#rpg-open{right:8px;top:62px;padding:7px 8px;font-size:12px}#rpg-panel{padding:7px}.rpg-dialog{max-height:96vh}#rpg-content{padding:10px}#rpg-tabs button{padding:6px;font-size:11px}#rpg-hud{font-size:10px;bottom:8px;left:8px;padding:7px} .rpg-item{align-items:flex-start}}

/* V7 compact desktop HUD: actions moved to G menu / keyboard shortcuts. */
#lq-toolbar > button[data-menu-shortcut] { display:none !important; }
#ai-mode-tabs { display:none !important; }
#lq-toolbar { max-width: min(80vw,620px); }
#ai-open { box-shadow:0 8px 25px #03152a90; }
#chat, #ai-panel, #rpg-panel .rpg-card { backdrop-filter:blur(11px); }

/* LIFEQUEST V9 — compact game HUD, accessible modern panel */
#v8-shell{font-family:Inter,system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:#eaf3ff;pointer-events:none}
#v8-shell button,#v8-shell input,#v8-shell select{font:inherit}
#v8-weather-canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;width:100%;height:100%;}
#v8-dock{position:fixed;z-index:24;left:13px;top:10px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;max-width:calc(100vw - 100px);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#12233aea,#192d44ed);border:1px solid #47678b;box-shadow:0 6px 24px #0009;pointer-events:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(11px)}
.v8-logo{color:#92daff;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.03em}.v8-logo b{color:#fff}.v8-logo em{font-style:normal;color:#f7d77c}
#v8-hud-time{font-size:11px;color:#b1c9d9;white-space:nowrap}
#v8-menu-btn{color:#f3f6ff;background:#37577d;border:1px solid #7298c3;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#v8-menu-btn:hover,#v8-open-quests:hover{background:#47739f}
#v8-navigation{position:fixed;z-index:21;top:70px;right:13px;width:min(242px,calc(100vw - 26px));padding:10px 12px;background:#121e31e9;border:1px solid #526e94;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 6px 22px #0009;pointer-events:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#v8-compass{display:block;color:#fce6a9;font-size:11px;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:7px;border-bottom:1px solid #3e5875;word-break:break-word}
.v8-quest-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}.v8-quest-head span{font-size:12px;color:#c6e4fa;font-weight:750}.v8-quest-head b{font-size:11px;color:#ffd97c;white-space:nowrap}
#v8-quest-text{font-size:11px;color:#b7c9dd;line-height:1.35;margin:7px 0;max-height:46px;overflow:hidden}
#v8-open-quests{font-size:11px;background:#2f5074;color:#edf5ff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #54779d;cursor:pointer}
#v8-map-wrap{position:fixed;z-index:21;bottom:14px;left:13px;background:#0d2033f0;border:1px solid #547492;border-radius:12px;padding:6px;box-shadow:0 6px 26px #000a;pointer-events:auto;overflow:hidden}
.v8-map-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:#d1e9f6;font-size:10px;margin:0 1px 5px 3px}.v8-map-head button{background:#213957;border:1px solid #476887;border-radius:5px;color:#eaf3ff;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;line-height:1;padding:0 5px}
#v8-map{display:block;border-radius:6px;image-rendering:pixelated}
#v8-toast{position:fixed;z-index:70;left:50%;top:13%;transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;background:#0d2949f8;color:#e7f8ff;border:1px solid #7ec9e4;border-radius:11px;padding:12px 18px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #000b;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;max-width:min(480px,85vw);pointer-events:none}
#v8-panel{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:78;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#04101fc8;pointer-events:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(5px);padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box}
#v8-panel>.v8-panel-head,#v8-panel>.v8-tabs,#v8-panel>.v8-page,#v8-panel>footer{width:min(770px,100%);box-sizing:border-box}
#v8-panel{flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.v8-panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#152943,#244c67);padding:15px 18px 11px;border:1px solid #597f9d;border-bottom:0;border-radius:17px 17px 0 0}
.v8-panel-head div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.v8-panel-head strong{font-size:17px;color:#f1f8ff}.v8-panel-head span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#b7e9f2}
#v8-close{border:1px solid #7199a7;background:#243e59;color:white;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.v8-tabs{display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:#17283d;padding:8px;border-left:1px solid #597f9d;border-right:1px solid #597f9d;overflow-x:auto;gap:5px}
.v8-tabs button{flex:1 0 auto;font-size:11px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 6px;color:#c4d6ec;background:#263d57;cursor:pointer}.v8-tabs button.active{background:#406a8e;color:white;border:1px solid #8bc7ee}
.v8-page{height:min(505px,60vh);overflow:auto;background:#122137;border:1px solid #597f9d;border-top:0;border-bottom:0;padding:15px 19px;user-select:text;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#d9e6f5}
.v8-page p{margin-top:6px}.v8-page h4{margin:17px 0 7px;color:#f5d58e}.v8-explain{color:#adc3d6;font-size:12px}
#v8-quests-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:8px}
.v8-quest-card{text-align:left;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;border:1px solid #405b79;border-radius:11px;background:#203650;color:white;padding:10px;cursor:pointer}
.v8-quest-card.active{border-color:#e9c678;background:#344d65}
.v8-quest-card strong{font-size:12px}.v8-quest-card small{color:#b8cce1;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35}.v8-quest-card span{font-size:10px;color:#bde9d3}
.v8-step{padding:9px;margin:6px 0;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #314561;color:#8faac1}.v8-step.finished{color:#98e9ca;border-color:#3a816d;background:#163c37}.v8-step.current{color:#fce9b2;border-color:#8e7745;background:#433b2e}
.v8-npc{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #304663}.v8-npc strong,.v8-npc small{display:block}.v8-npc small{font-size:11px;color:#92abc4}.v8-npc span{font-size:10px;color:#fbc3ce}
.v8-meter{height:5px;width:75px;background:#34425b;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:5px}.v8-meter i{display:block;background:#d87098;height:100%}
.v8-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.v8-options label{background:#1d3049;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}.v8-options input{accent-color:#6dbbd2}.v8-options select{background:#324a65;color:white;border:1px solid #7ca6cd;padding:5px;border-radius:6px;max-width:120px}
.v8-primary,#v8-import{border:1px solid #85aec3;background:#335f80;color:#effaff;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;cursor:pointer}.v8-primary:hover,#v8-import:hover{background:#447a9e}.v8-save-row{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.v8-journal-item{padding:8px 10px;background:#1b2e46;border-left:3px solid #91d3e1;margin:6px 0;font-size:12px}
#v8-panel>footer{background:#17283d;border:1px solid #597f9d;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 17px 17px;padding:11px 16px;text-align:center;color:#8fb3d0;font-size:11px}
body.v8-contrast #v8-navigation,body.v8-contrast #v8-map-wrap,body.v8-contrast #v8-dock{background:#07121f;border-color:#fff}
body.v8-contrast .v8-page,body.v8-contrast .v8-tabs{background:#07121f;color:white}
/* V7 retains its original app's controls and functions; only duplicate brand/menu chips are removed. */
#lq-toolbar .lq-brand{display:none!important}
#lq-toolbar{top:auto!important;bottom:14px!important;left:240px!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 325px)!important}
#lq-toolbar button:not(#rpg-open){font-size:11px;padding:7px 9px}
#group-btn{top:12px;right:13px;font-size:12px;padding:9px 13px}
#group-menu{top:54px;bottom:16px;width:min(240px,80vw)}
@media (max-width:900px){#v8-navigation{top:55px;right:8px;width:185px}#v8-dock{left:6px;top:6px;gap:5px;padding:7px}#v8-hud-time{display:none}#lq-toolbar{left:8px!important;bottom:153px!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 190px)!important}#v8-map-wrap{left:7px;bottom:7px;transform:scale(.86);transform-origin:bottom left}}
@media (max-width:540px){#v8-navigation{width:150px;top:54px}#v8-map-wrap{transform:scale(.72)}#v8-dock{font-size:10px}#v8-panel>.v8-page{height:65vh} .v8-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}#v8-panel{padding:5px}#v8-navigation p{font-size:10px}}

#ai-mode-tabs{display:none!important}
#ai-suggestions{max-height:50px;overflow-x:auto}

#mobile-controls,#touch-controls,.mobile-controls,.touch-controls,#virtual-joystick{display:none!important}

/* V9 Cinematic UI: polished but restrained, avoiding any additional movement controls */
#chat, .lq-modal > div, #v8-panel, #group-menu {box-shadow:0 18px 55px rgba(3,9,28,.69),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(15px)}
#group-btn {background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1c2944,#121b30);box-shadow:0 4px 16px #0007,0 0 18px #7fa6e52c;border-color:#7fa1df!important}
#game canvas {image-rendering:pixelated;}
/* V10 economy UI; independent from V9 Phaser layers. */
#v10-open{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#28628c,#19435f);border:1px solid #8cbdf2;color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #0007;cursor:pointer}
#v10-open:hover{filter:brightness(1.13)}
#v10-panel[hidden],#v10-quiz[hidden],#v10-npc-shop[hidden]{display:none!important}
#v10-panel{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:25000;background:#06101cd9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;color:#e8f4ff}
#v10-dialog{width:min(920px,95vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #86bde8;box-shadow:0 20px 75px #000b,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff19;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#203451,#0b192b 72%);padding:17px}
#v10-dialog header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
#v10-dialog h2{font-size:18px;margin:0;color:#fff;line-height:1.3}
#v10-dialog h3{font-size:17px;margin:15px 0 9px;color:#b8e3ff}
#v10-balance{font-size:13px;color:#b2e5ff;margin:9px 0}
#v10-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0}
#v10-dialog button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #648fb8;border-radius:8px;background:#254868;color:#fff;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650}
#v10-dialog button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#3973a2}
#v10-dialog button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffe09a;outline-offset:2px}
#v10-dialog button:disabled{opacity:.44;cursor:not-allowed}
#v10-tabs button.active{background:#d4a146;color:#152638;border-color:#ffe6ae}
#v10-content{max-height:58vh;overflow:auto;scrollbar-color:#4d7a9a #14263e}
#v10-content label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;margin:10px 0}
#v10-content select,#v10-content input{display:block;margin-top:6px;padding:9px 10px;background:#091727;color:#e5f4ff;border:1px solid #6a9bc7;border-radius:7px;max-width:100%;min-width:110px}
#v10-content select{width:min(460px,100%)}
.v10-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:10px 0}
.v10-row>b{font-size:12px;color:#bee1d0}
.v10-help{color:#bbd7eb;background:#122842;border-left:3px solid #dcb367;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.v10-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(202px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0}
.v10-item{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#1c344e,#14283d);padding:12px;border:1px solid #3a6285;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0003;min-height:105px}
.v10-item strong,.v10-item b{color:#fff}
.v10-item p{color:#b6cadc;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;margin:8px 0}
.v10-item small{color:#bbd7eb}
.v10-item button{font-size:12px!important;padding:6px 10px!important}
.v10-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.v10-summary span{display:grid;gap:2px;background:#1d3a55;border:1px solid #3b698d;padding:14px;border-radius:10px;min-width:142px}
.v10-summary b{color:#ffdb85;font-size:20px}
.v10-ledger{max-height:38vh;overflow:auto}
.v10-ledger>div{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #3b5267;padding:9px 3px}
.v10-ledger span{display:grid;gap:3px}.v10-ledger small{color:#98b3c9}.v10-ledger .expense{color:#ff9f9f}.v10-ledger .income{color:#9be2ad}
#v10-status{background:#0c263b;color:#b9f2dc;border:1px solid #406f84;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;margin-top:12px;min-height:26px;font-size:13px}
#v10-quiz{padding:11px;background:#123451;border:1px solid #75b5d8;margin:8px 0;border-radius:10px}

@media(max-width:540px){#v10-dialog{padding:10px}#v10-content{max-height:64vh}.v10-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#v10-dialog h2{font-size:15px}}



/* LIFEQUEST V11 - VISUAL SYSTEM AND ONE-NAV SHELL */
:root{--l11-bg:#0c172a;--l11-surface:#14243a;--l11-surface2:#20354e;--l11-line:#38546d;--l11-ink:#ecf4ff;--l11-muted:#a7bbcf;--l11-blue:#5aa7fa;--l11-gold:#f0c56e;--l11-green:#89d6ae;--l11-red:#f5a7a7;--l11-radius:13px;--l11-shadow:0 22px 70px #0009}
#lq-toolbar,#group-btn,#group-menu,#rpg-open,#rpg-hud,#v10-open,#v8-dock,#v8-menu-btn{display:none!important}
#v8-map-wrap{position:fixed!important;left:15px!important;bottom:79px!important;top:auto!important;right:auto!important;z-index:17!important;max-width:min(204px,32vw)!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px #0008)}
#v8-navigation{pointer-events:none;z-index:14!important}
#ai-open[hidden]{display:none!important}
#ai-open{position:fixed!important;right:15px!important;bottom:17px!important;top:auto!important;left:auto!important;width:auto!important;max-width:240px!important;height:auto!important;min-height:40px!important;font-weight:800!important;padding:10px 15px!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#2566a0!important;border:1px solid #90baf1!important;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #020b1a88!important;z-index:22!important;font-size:13px!important}
#ai-panel{z-index:102!important;max-height:min(83vh,760px)!important;box-shadow:var(--l11-shadow)!important}
#chat,#helper,#settings,#quests,#journal,#briefing{z-index:105!important;max-width:96vw!important;box-sizing:border-box}
#rpg-panel,#v10-panel,#v8-panel,.lq-modal{z-index:106!important}
#l11-top{position:fixed;inset:14px 15px auto;z-index:19;pointer-events:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff}
#l11-brand,#l11-current,#l11-menu-btn,#l11-progress{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#101e34eF,#172b45ed);border:1px solid #6489aa77;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0006;pointer-events:auto}
#l11-brand{padding:9px 14px;min-width:180px;display:grid;gap:2px}
#l11-brand b{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.25px;color:#ffe9b8}
#l11-brand span{font-size:11px;color:#bed6e7}
#l11-headright{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:45vw}
#l11-current{padding:8px 12px;max-width:360px;min-width:135px;display:grid;gap:3px}
#l11-current b{font-size:12px;color:#ffdf98}
#l11-current span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;color:#e8f0fb;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
#l11-menu-btn{padding:10px 13px;border-color:#6d92bf;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
#l11-menu-btn:hover{background:#28517d}
#l11-bottom{position:fixed;left:15px;bottom:13px;z-index:19;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;pointer-events:none}
#l11-progress{padding:8px 11px;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#ffecc4}
#l11-progress .sub{color:#a6c8df;font-size:11px}
#l11-hint{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:18;background:#10233fdf;border:1px solid #7197bd;padding:8px 14px;color:#ffe5ad;box-shadow:0 6px 25px #0008;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;max-width:min(450px,63vw);text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
#l11-hint[hidden],#l11-current[hidden],#l11-shell[hidden]{display:none!important}
#l11-shell{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:#060d1bc9;backdrop-filter:blur(5px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--l11-ink)}
#l11-dialog{width:min(1000px,100%);height:min(790px,88vh);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#101e33,#13263d);border:1px solid #537697;box-shadow:var(--l11-shadow);border-radius:17px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#l11-dialog>header{flex:none;padding:17px 19px;border-bottom:1px solid #38536c;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:#142741}
#l11-dialog h2{font-size:18px!important;color:#f2f7ff!important;margin:0 0 4px!important}
#l11-dialog p{margin:0;color:#a7c0d5;font-size:12px}
#l11-close{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:#243d56;color:#fff;border:1px solid #58799e;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px}
#l11-menu-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:176px minmax(0,1fr);flex:1;min-height:0}
#l11-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:15px 10px;border-right:1px solid #34516c;background:#0e1b2d;overflow:auto}
#l11-nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;padding:12px 10px;background:transparent;color:#d4e6f8;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer}
#l11-nav button:hover{background:#243d58}#l11-nav button.active{background:#214c79;border-color:#659de3;color:#fff}
#l11-page{padding:23px;overflow:auto;min-width:0;overscroll-behavior:contain}
#l11-page h3{margin:0 0 5px;color:#fff;font-size:20px}#l11-page .l11-explain{color:#a6bed0;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:17px;line-height:1.6}
.l11-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.l11-card{border:1px solid #3d5a76;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1c334b,#14273c);padding:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:90px}
.l11-card b{font-size:14px;color:#f2f6fd}.l11-card p{color:#c1d1df!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.5;margin:0!important}
.l11-card button,.l11-action{align-self:flex-start;padding:8px 12px;background:#2966a3;border:1px solid #85b8ef;border-radius:8px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-weight:750;font-size:12px}
.l11-card button:hover,.l11-action:hover{background:#397eb9}
.l11-statline{background:#101f33;border:1px solid #385471;padding:14px;border-radius:10px;line-height:1.8;font-size:13px;color:#d6e5f5;margin-bottom:15px}
.l11-pill{color:#ffdf91;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
#l11-foot{padding:9px 18px;border-top:1px solid #35516a;color:#9eb5ca;font-size:11px;flex:none}
#l11-menu-btn:focus-visible,#l11-shell button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffd06d;outline-offset:2px}
#chat input,#ai-input{font-size:15px!important}
@media (max-width:720px){#l11-top{inset:9px 9px auto;gap:6px}#l11-brand{min-width:0;padding:8px 9px}#l11-brand b{font-size:12px}#l11-brand span{font-size:10px}#l11-headright{max-width:55vw}#l11-current{display:none}#l11-menu-btn{padding:10px;font-size:12px}#l11-shell{padding:7px}#l11-dialog{height:min(94vh,920px);border-radius:12px}#l11-menu-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr)}#l11-nav{flex-direction:row;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #35516a;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px;gap:3px}#l11-nav button{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 10px}#l11-page{padding:15px} .l11-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#ai-open{font-size:11px!important;padding:9px 10px!important;right:8px!important;bottom:8px!important}#l11-bottom{left:8px;bottom:8px}#l11-hint{bottom:60px;font-size:11px}#v8-map-wrap{left:8px!important;bottom:60px!important;max-width:145px!important}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#l11-shell,#l11-dialog{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}


/* LifeQuest V12.1 - refined minimap: original map coordinates and gameplay preserved. */
#v8-map-wrap{width:270px!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px)!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;bottom:80px!important;left:14px!important;transform:none!important;padding:9px!important;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#102b3beb,#152538f3)!important;border:1px solid #77a8b8aa!important;border-radius:15px!important;box-shadow:0 12px 38px #0009,inset 0 1px #ffffff20!important;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#v8-map-wrap[hidden]{display:none!important}
#v8-map-wrap .v8-map-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#ebf5ff;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;margin:0 0 7px 1px;min-height:23px}
#v8-map-hide{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1!important;width:23px!important;height:23px!important;border-radius:6px!important;color:#ccebf5!important;border-color:#679bb8!important}
#v8-map{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-width:252px!important;aspect-ratio:252 / 164!important;background:#1b3e46;border:1px solid #547d8b;border-radius:9px!important;box-sizing:border-box;image-rendering:auto!important}
#v8-map-legend{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:13px;padding:7px 0 1px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#b6d6dd}
#v8-map-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;white-space:nowrap}
.lqmap-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #07151ecc}
.lqmap-dot.player{background:#ffda86;border:1px solid #fff2d4}.lqmap-dot.npc{background:#c9f0f3}.lqmap-dot.target{background:transparent;border:2px solid #ffdb7d;box-sizing:border-box}
@media(max-width:700px){#v8-map-wrap{left:8px!important;bottom:68px!important;width:208px!important;padding:6px!important}#v8-map-wrap .v8-map-head{font-size:10px}#v8-map-legend{font-size:9px;gap:7px}#v8-map{width:100%!important}}

/* Quest card fold button (the card itself ignores the mouse, so the button turns it back on). */
#v8-nav-toggle{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #679bb8;background:#213957;color:#eaf3ff;font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:0}
#v8-nav-toggle:hover{background:#2f5074}
#v8-compass{padding-right:26px}
#v8-navigation.collapsed{padding:4px;width:auto;background:#121e31cc}
#v8-navigation.collapsed>:not(#v8-nav-toggle){display:none!important}
#v8-navigation.collapsed #v8-nav-toggle{position:static;width:auto;height:24px;padding:0 9px;font-size:12px}
/* ART DISTRICT — same LIFEQUEST chat shell, individual street-art accents. */
#chat[data-npc-theme] {
  border-color: var(--npc-accent, #5a6a9a);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px #000b, inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 24%, transparent);
}
#chat[data-npc-theme] .name { color: var(--npc-accent); text-shadow: 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 35%, transparent); }
#chat[data-npc-theme] .goal { border-left: 3px solid var(--npc-accent); padding-left: 9px; }
#chat[data-npc-theme] input:focus { border-color: var(--npc-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 22%, transparent); }
#chat[data-npc-theme] #npc-suggest { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 70%, #26364c); }
#chat[data-npc-theme="rook"] { --npc-accent: #e7a1ff; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="vex"] { --npc-accent: #35d5df; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="morrow"] { --npc-accent: #b79aff; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="noor"] { --npc-accent: #ff5d9b; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="ivo"] { --npc-accent: #42dce7; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="ada"] { --npc-accent: #ffbd52; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="kai"] { --npc-accent: #ff8b54; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="mira"] { --npc-accent: #83d58b; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="ren"] { --npc-accent: #70bfff; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="sol"] { --npc-accent: #c39cff; }


/* V12.3 - Map travel selector: responsive list of the real game worlds. */
.l11-map-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.l11-map-summary b{color:#fff}
.l11-map-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.l11-map-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#182d43,#102136);border:1px solid #44627e;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #030c1a4d;transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s}
.l11-map-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#96c8ee}
.l11-map-card.is-current{border-color:#d9ae63;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #d9ae6355,0 8px 22px #030c1a55}
.l11-map-visual{min-height:88px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1d5c83,#2c776b 57%,#3b6952)}
.l11-map-visual::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -5% -42% -5%;height:90%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#ffffff2c,#00000019);transform:rotate(-8deg);border-top:3px solid #ffffff22;z-index:-1}
.l11-map-mine{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#294d64,#655e4a 64%,#333b4b)}
.l11-map-art{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#543777,#a0477c 54%,#3b5a7f)}
.l11-map-past{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#75694b,#7f8758 50%,#3e685d)}
.l11-map-symbol{font-size:43px;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 6px #050a18a8);line-height:1}
.l11-map-number{position:absolute;top:9px;right:10px;font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f0f7ff;background:#0615227d;padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid #ffffff2a;border-radius:999px}
.l11-map-content{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:14px 16px 16px}
.l11-map-region{font:800 10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#f2cf85}
#l11-page .l11-map-content h4{margin:0;color:#f4f7ff;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35}
#l11-page .l11-map-content p{color:#b8cddd;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;margin:0 0 10px;flex:1}
.l11-map-content button{align-self:stretch;border:1px solid #8dc0ee;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#256ab1,#2e7cba);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;padding:10px 9px;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px}
.l11-map-content button:hover:not(:disabled){background:linear-gradient(120deg,#398bd4,#359bd0)}
.l11-map-content button:disabled{cursor:default;color:#ffe7a7;background:#55452c;border-color:#997849}
#l11-page .l11-map-notice{color:#a9c5d9;font-size:11px;margin:15px 0 0;line-height:1.6}
@media (max-width:740px){.l11-map-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.l11-map-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px minmax(0,1fr)}.l11-map-visual{min-height:100%;height:100%;}.l11-map-symbol{font-size:35px}.l11-map-number{font-size:8px;right:4px;top:7px}.l11-map-content{padding:12px}.l11-map-content button{min-height:38px}}
@media (max-width:340px){.l11-map-card{grid-template-columns:68px minmax(0,1fr)}.l11-map-symbol{font-size:29px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.l11-map-card{transition:none}}

/* V13: each destination now previews its authored environmental landmarks. */
.l11-map-features{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin:-3px 0 12px}
.l11-map-features span{font:700 9px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#cbdff3;background:#21364c;border:1px solid #415771;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 6px;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.l11-map-card:hover .l11-map-features span{border-color:#678bb1}
@media(max-width:480px){.l11-map-features span:nth-child(n+3){display:none}}
.l11-map-tracked{display:block;color:#f2d38e;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.015em;margin:-4px 0 9px}

<!-- LifeQuest V51: additive gameplay styles. -->
<style>
/* LIFEQUEST V51 – responsive isolated HUD. Does not restyle existing pixels/NPCs. */
#lq51-root{font:13px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:#eaf3ff}
#lq51-root [hidden]{display:none!important}
#lq51-root button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
#lq51-open{position:fixed;z-index:47;right:15px;bottom:77px;min-height:37px;padding:8px 12px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#254a5f,#172b45);border:1px solid #7fd6d3;border-radius:10px;color:#e2fff6;font-weight:760;box-shadow:0 5px 24px #0008}
#lq51-open:hover{background:#335b74}
#lq51-open small{font-size:9px;color:#d8ca87;vertical-align:top;margin-left:6px}
#lq51-prompt{position:fixed;z-index:48;left:50%;bottom:78px;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:min(470px,82vw);padding:8px 14px;background:#172b41ef;color:#f5e7b7;border:1px solid #c5ad78;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0009;font-weight:740;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
#lq51-prompt:hover{background:#344967}
#lq51-direction{position:fixed;bottom:121px;right:15px;z-index:41;font-size:11px;padding:7px 11px;background:#10283ce8;border:1px solid #709eac;border-radius:9px;max-width:250px;color:#d3e9f8}
#lq51-toast{position:fixed;z-index:390;top:17%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 18px;max-width:90vw;background:#173e3bef;border:1px solid #a5e6c6;color:#e6fff2;border-radius:11px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000a;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
#lq51-dialog{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:360;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#030915ce;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box}
#lq51-dialog .lq51-panel{width:min(980px,100%);height:min(790px,92vh);background:linear-gradient(157deg,#162b40,#0f192a 88%);border:1px solid #60839d;box-shadow:0 24px 75px #000c;border-radius:17px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#lq51-root .lq51-header{padding:14px 19px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #3f6078;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#24455b,#172b44)}
#lq51-root .lq51-header small{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#98d1cd}
#lq51-root .lq51-header h2{font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;margin:3px 0;color:#ffdfa8}
#lq51-context{font-size:11px;color:#b7d1e4}
#lq51-close{font-size:20px!important;background:#263d53;border:1px solid #6891aa;border-radius:9px;width:38px;height:38px;color:white}
#lq51-root .lq51-tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow:auto;flex:none;background:#13273b;padding:9px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #334d65}
#lq51-root .lq51-tabs button{flex:1 0 auto;border:1px solid #3f5a72;background:#21374d;color:#c6dbea;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:12px}
#lq51-root .lq51-tabs button.selected{background:#32657c;border-color:#95d6db;color:white;font-weight:700}
#lq51-content{padding:17px 21px;overflow:auto;flex:1;user-select:text}
#lq51-root .lq51-panel footer{padding:10px 16px;color:#93b6c6;border-top:1px solid #344c61;font-size:10px;background:#112336;text-align:center}
#lq51-content h2{font-size:22px;margin:8px 0 12px;line-height:1.25;color:#fce0aa}
#lq51-content h3{font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;margin:15px 0 9px;color:#d9edf8}
#lq51-content p{line-height:1.58}
#lq51-content button{background:#244560;color:#eaf5ff;border:1px solid #6c9abc;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px}
#lq51-content button:hover{background:#306685}
#lq51-content button:focus-visible,#lq51-close:focus-visible,#lq51-open:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffdd8b;outline-offset:2px}
#lq51-content button.selected{border-color:#f9d48d;background:#35536b}
#lq51-content button.lq51-primary{background:#2d7474;border-color:#8ddbd0;font-weight:750;margin-top:9px}
.lq51-hero{padding:20px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#20495d,#222d50);border:1px solid #5c8295;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff0a;margin-bottom:17px}
.lq51-hero small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#9adfda;font-weight:750}
.lq51-hero h2{font-size:25px!important;margin:4px 0 6px!important}
.lq51-hero p{margin:4px 0 10px;color:#c8dde9}
.lq51-pill{display:inline-block;background:#204b4f;color:#b3f0dd;border:1px solid #487f80;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:30px;font-size:11px}
.lq51-sectionhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:9px 0 10px}
.lq51-sectionhead h3{margin:0!important}.lq51-sectionhead span{font-size:11px;color:#a9c8d8}
.lq51-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:12px}
.lq51-card{padding:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#192f45;border:1px solid #416379;border-radius:12px;min-height:183px}
.lq51-card strong{font-size:16px;color:#f4e6c4;margin:8px 0 3px}
.lq51-card p{color:#b8d1e0;font-size:12px;flex:1;margin:5px 0 13px}
.lq51-card-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:#adc6d3}
.lq51-card-top .lq51-glyph{font:bold 17px monospace;display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:6px;background:#466577;color:#ffe6ad;border:1px solid #6f94a3}
.lq51-done{color:#91edc0!important}
.lq51-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:8px 0}
.lq51-advice,.lq51-note{font-size:11px;color:#a8bdcc;background:#15283b;border-left:3px solid #7ea8af;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin-top:15px}
.lq51-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:12px;color:#8abed4;font-size:11px}
.lq51-desc{color:#bad2df;background:#1b3447;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #3e6279;padding:12px;margin:10px 0 17px}
.lq51-step{color:#96dacb;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.lq51-answers{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin:15px 0 8px}
.lq51-answers button{text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#1f3850!important;padding:12px!important;border-radius:9px!important}
.lq51-answers button:hover{background:#315d7a!important;border-color:#a0d8e9!important}
.lq51-answers button span{background:#385b70;border:1px solid #7291a5;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700}
.lq51-error{background:#472c39;color:#ffc6c3;border:1px solid #bc7984;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:13px;border-radius:8px}
.lq51-success{background:#1d4b42;color:#bcf4d6;border:1px solid #68bfa2;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:13px;border-radius:8px}
.lq51-small,.lq51-muted{color:#b4c9d8;font-size:12px}
#lq51-writing{display:block;background:#0c1d2e;color:#f0f7fc;border:1px solid #7197a8;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;min-height:115px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin:8px 0;font:13px/1.6 system-ui;resize:vertical}
.lq51-art{padding:13px;background:#101e34;border:1px solid #415774;border-radius:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin:16px auto;width:max-content;max-width:100%;color:#c8dae8;letter-spacing:.11em;font-size:10px}
.lq51-pixels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,19px);grid-template-rows:repeat(8,19px);image-rendering:pixelated;border:8px solid #524a54;box-shadow:0 7px 20px #000a}
.lq51-pixels i{width:19px;height:19px;display:block}
.lq51-colorchoices{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.lq51-colorchoices button{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:12px}
.lq51-colorchoices span{height:20px;width:45px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #9db1aa}
.lq51-label{font-size:12px;color:#bed5e4;font-weight:800;margin:17px 0 6px}
.lq51-regions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:9px}
.lq51-region{padding:12px;background:#1b3448;border:1px solid #41647b;border-radius:10px;display:grid;gap:5px}
.lq51-region b{font-size:12px;color:#dfedfc}.lq51-region span{font-size:11px;color:#93c3d6}
.lq51-meter{height:6px;background:#31445b;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden}.lq51-meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:#88d5b5}
.lq51-timeline{border-left:2px solid #6290b0;background:#1a3044;padding:9px 12px;margin:7px 0;font-size:12px}.lq51-timeline small{display:block;color:#95b2c7}
.lq51-npc{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border:1px solid #35546a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin:7px 0;background:#172c40}
.lq51-npc div{display:grid;gap:2px}.lq51-npc strong{font-size:13px}.lq51-npc small{font-size:10px;color:#90b5ce}.lq51-npc span{font-size:11px;color:#9ce3cf}
.lq51-debug{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(100px,1fr) 1fr;gap:9px 12px;background:#182f43;padding:15px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #42647b}
.lq51-debug div{color:#9fc3d3}.lq51-debug b{font:600 12px monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
body.lq-mine-playing #lq51-open,body.lq-mine-playing #lq51-prompt,body.lq-mine-playing #lq51-direction{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
@media(max-width:680px){#lq51-dialog{padding:5px}#lq51-dialog .lq51-panel{height:96dvh;border-radius:10px}#lq51-content{padding:12px}#lq51-root .lq51-header{padding:11px}#lq51-root .lq51-header h2{font-size:18px}.lq51-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#lq51-open{bottom:134px;right:8px;padding:7px 10px}#lq51-prompt{bottom:132px;font-size:11px}#lq51-direction{bottom:181px;right:8px;max-width:155px}.lq51-hero{padding:14px}}

</style>

<style>
/* V52 overlay is independent of original LifeQuest menus, graphics and sprites. */
#lq52-root{font:13px/1.56 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#eaf3ff;pointer-events:none}
#lq52-root [hidden]{display:none!important}
#lq52-root button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:#f3f9ff;border:1px solid #648ca7;border-radius:9px;background:#25435b;padding:8px 12px;pointer-events:auto}
#lq52-root button:hover{background:#38607a}
#lq52-chip{position:fixed;bottom:126px;right:14px;z-index:46;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#204736,#1d384e)!important;border-color:#74b79a!important;color:#bff4de!important;font-weight:780!important;max-width:min(300px,52vw);box-shadow:0 8px 20px #0008;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
#lq52-prompt{position:fixed;bottom:124px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:48;background:#18364cde!important;border-color:#efc985!important;color:#ffe4ac!important;font-weight:770!important;max-width:min(450px,70vw);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#lq52-toast{position:fixed;top:17%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:408;max-width:min(520px,90vw);padding:12px 17px;background:#193c36f2;border:1px solid #85ddaa;border-radius:12px;color:#e2ffed;box-shadow:0 9px 35px #000a;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
#lq52-modal,#lq52-menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:405;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;background:#050c1ad2;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);pointer-events:auto}
#lq52-modal .lq52-panel,#lq52-menu .lq52-panel{width:min(600px,100%);max-height:min(760px,89vh);overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1a3548,#0e1b2f);border:1px solid #6c9aa6;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #000c;padding:20px 23px;color:#dceef7}
#lq52-menu .lq52-panel{width:min(760px,100%)}
#lq52-root .lq52-panel header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;border-bottom:1px solid #42647a;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:10px}
#lq52-root .lq52-panel header b{font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#f9dba5}
#lq52-root .lq52-panel header button{font-size:17px;padding:3px 10px}
#lq52-description{white-space:pre-line;color:#d0e6ee;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}
#lq52-actions,.lq52-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
#lq52-root button.primary{background:#31735d!important;border-color:#9bdcb9!important;font-weight:760}
#lq52-root button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffdda3;outline-offset:2px}
#lq52-root .lq52-card{margin:12px 0;padding:14px 16px;background:#1b3547;border:1px solid #446979;border-radius:12px}
#lq52-root .lq52-card b{font-size:14px;color:#f3e3be}
#lq52-root .lq52-card p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin:7px 0;color:#c1dae7}
#lq52-root .lq52-done{color:#9eeac2!important}
#lq52-root .lq52-log{border-left:2px solid #75afbd;padding:7px 12px;margin:7px 0;background:#1b3548;font-size:12px}
#lq52-root h3{font-size:14px;color:#efdaad}
#lq52-root kbd{display:inline-block;background:#102435;border:1px solid #60839b;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;color:#f5d9a8}
body.lq-mine-playing #lq52-chip,body.lq-mine-playing #lq52-prompt{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:680px){#lq52-chip{bottom:184px;right:7px;font-size:10px;padding:7px 8px}#lq52-prompt{bottom:184px;max-width:60vw;font-size:10px}#lq52-modal .lq52-panel,#lq52-menu .lq52-panel{padding:13px;max-height:92vh}#lq52-root .lq52-panel header b{font-size:16px}#lq52-actions button,.lq52-actions button{flex:1 1 180px}}
#lq52-english-sentence{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:83px;padding:11px 13px;color:#f4fafb;background:#101f31;border:1px solid #77abc3;border-radius:10px;resize:vertical;font:13px/1.5 system-ui;margin:12px 0}
#lq52-english-sentence:focus{outline:2px solid #96dcc9}

</style>
